ExtraBar 1.2.5 – Pick It, Link It, Launch It! 🎨🔗

✨ What's New & Improved

  • Unified Icon Picker: A brand-new icon picker sheet combining Library, SF Symbols, App Icons, and URL icons – one beautiful picker for all your icon needs!
  • Icons Everywhere: The unified picker is now available across bar items, widgets, and folder items – consistent icon customization everywhere you look!
  • Widget Custom Icons: Widgets now support custom icon overrides! Set SF Symbols, app icons, library icons, or URL icons on any widget with new customization properties!
  • Custom Icons in All Modes: Custom icons render perfectly in both the floating bar and menu bar inline mode!

🔗 Action Deep Links

  • URL Scheme Actions: A powerful new deep link system lets you execute actions directly via URL scheme (extrabar://action/...)!
  • 4 Action Kinds: Supports menu actions, action widgets, folder widget actions, and folder widget app menu actions – trigger anything from anywhere!
  • Copy Deep Link: New "Copy Deep Link" button in menu configuration, folder widget editors, and widget app menu editors – easily share or automate any action!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • SF Symbol Categories: Fixed category filtering in the symbol picker for proper browsing!
  • Code Cleanup: Various optimizations and code improvements under the hood!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
